units.source_text: 尽管如此，也不能认为这些断片是过去曾经塑造成美丽而完整的形态所失落的碎片。

en.t: Even so, these fragments cannot be regarded as lost pieces of some form that was once shaped into something beautiful and complete.

units.source_text: 虽然他们在无意义之中，在完全缺乏规律性的情况之下，被世人当做不像样的形态而抛弃了，但他们各自都在撞憬着它们的未来。

en.t: Although, amid meaninglessness and under conditions utterly lacking in order, they had been cast aside by the world as misshapen forms, each of them was still yearning for its own future.

units.source_text: 它们以碎片低微的身份，毫不畏惧地、不愉快地、沉静地……撞憬着未来！

en.t: In their lowly status as fragments, they yearned for the future fearlessly, unpleasantly, and quietly... yearned for the future!

units.source_text: 憧憬着决不会痊愈和康复的、手够不着的。

en.t: They yearned for what would never heal or recover, for what lay beyond their reach.

units.source_text: 真正是前代未闻的未来！

en.t: It was truly an unprecedented future!
